description: OpenAQ - PM1 is a dataset listed in FEMA Disaster Resilience Hub, a disaster resilience data hub, published or maintained by Esri. Every day activities such as driving, burning coal for electricity, wildfires, running factories, even cooking and cleaning, release particles into the air. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Esri. Its keywords are Air Quality, PM2.5, Global, livefeeds2, earth observations, environment, esri_environment, OpenAQ. The bounding box given is -162.5714,-69.5410,177.5259,69.6596. The hub shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Esri Master License Agreement (terms of use of the source layer, not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fema-resilience-hub.
